theme: Hybrid (Light Content with Dark Cinematic Sections)
vibe: Cinematic, editorial, deeply modern, high-end luxury brand (₹5,00,000+ agency feel)

primary.name: Muted Gold
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, accents, hover states, icons, and subtle borders. Provides the luxury feel without being overwhelmingly shiny.

background_light.name: Warm Off-White
background_light.usage: Primary background for content-heavy sections like About, Services, Portfolio, Contact.

background_dark.name: Deep Charcoal
background_dark.usage: Hero section, Footer, Admin Sidebar, and alternate dark thematic sections. Use heavy contrast.

text_primary_light.name: Charcoal Text
text_primary_light.usage: Headings and body text on light backgrounds.

text_primary_dark.name: Off-White Text
text_primary_dark.usage: Headings and body text on dark backgrounds.

border_light.name: Subtle Gold/Gray
border_light.usage: Dividers and card borders on light theme.

border_dark.name: Dark Glass Border
border_dark.usage: Dividers, glassmorphism borders on dark theme.

primary_font.usage: H1, H2, H3 (Hero, Section Titles, Modal Titles). Must use tracking-tight and leading-none/tight.

secondary_font.usage: H4, Body Text, Buttons, Navigation, Admin Dashboard, Overlines (Uppercase + wide tracking).

interactions_and_motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis for buttery smooth scrolling with a custom scroll progress bar fixed at the top (Muted Gold).
interactions_and_motion.custom_cursor: Framer Motion based custom cursor: a subtle spotlight or trailing dot that expands on hoverable elements.
interactions_and_motion.page_loader: Elegant 1-2s initial page loader with a dark background, revealing the logo or brand name in Playfair Display, fading out smoothly.
interactions_and_motion.entrance_animations: Staggered fade-up and slide-in for typography and cards as they enter the viewport using Framer Motion (whileInView).
interactions_and_motion.hover_effects: Cards have a subtle Y-axis lift (-translate-y-2) and a soft muted gold glow. Images have a slow scale effect (scale-105) inside a hidden overflow container.
interactions_and_motion.parallax: Hero background image and portfolio images should use a slight parallax scroll effect to create cinematic depth.
interactions_and_motion.navbar: Sticky header. Starts fully transparent over the hero, transitions to a frosted glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/70) on scroll. Includes animated hamburger for mobile.

surface_strategies.glassmorphism: Used for Testimonial Carousel and Navbar. Heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl), slight white/black tint, and a delicate 1px inner stroke.
surface_strategies.cards: Services and Why Choose Us: Minimalist. Flat background matching the section, separated by a 1px solid subtle border, lifting on hover with a soft shadow.

hero.description: Dining room with gold floral wallpaper. Used as the main cinematic full-screen hero background.

portfolio_and_general.description: Dining room with gold floral wallpaper.
Floral wallpaper lounge. (Can be used in About Us section).

media.guidelines: CRITICAL: The user explicitly stated 'ONLY client-uploaded photos, no stock' for Portfolio. Do not use any placeholder or external image links. Use the provided 5 URLs across the site for visual assets.

landing.Hero: Full-screen cinematic (h-screen). Background image with black/40 overlay. Parallax effect. Word-by-word animated headline (Framer Motion). Two bold CTAs.
landing.About_Us: Warm editorial split-layout (text on one side, image on the other). Fade-in on scroll. Animated count-up numbers for years of experience or projects completed.
landing.Portfolio: Masonry grid using the 5 provided client photos. Clickable items that open a full-screen Lightbox modal. Parallax scroll effect on the images.
landing.Services: 13 animated icon cards (using lucide-react icons). Cards have hover lift and muted gold glow. Services: Wallpaper, PVC flooring, Laminates, Customised wallpaper, PVC planks, Wooden flooring, Artificial grass, Artificial planters, Blinds, Customised blinds, Glass film, PVC laminates, 3D panels.
landing.Why_Choose_Us: 4-5 differentiators with icon + text. Grid layout. Stagger reveal on scroll.
landing.Testimonials: Auto-scrolling glass-morphism carousel (use Framer Motion or Swiper). Mock 24 real Google reviews. Placed on a dark or image-backed section to make the glass pop.
landing.Contact: Floating-label inputs for the form, smooth focus effects. Embedded Google Map. Floating WhatsApp action button (FAB) fixed to the bottom right.
landing.Footer: Premium dark footer (Deep Charcoal background). Large logo or 'Fashion Interior' brand mark. Essential links, social icons.

admin_dashboard.vibe: Premium clean, Archetype 4 (Swiss/High-Contrast) but utilizing brand colors. Dark sidebar (Deep Charcoal) + Light content area (Warm Off-White).
admin_dashboard.components: Heavily use Shadcn UI (Tables, Dialogs, Inputs, Dropdowns, Tabs, Forms).
sections: Secure Login & Forgot Password (mock Resend-branded reset email).
Portfolio Manager: Grid view to upload/edit/delete/reorder images.
Inquiries Inbox: Sortable Shadcn Table for contact submissions.
Testimonials Manager: List to add/edit reviews.
Settings: Form to change admin credentials and business info.

testing_strategy.data_testids: All interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, links, navigation items, and cards MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case (e.g., 'data-testid="hero-explore-button"', 'data-testid="contact-submit-btn"').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Warm Off-White, Deep Charcoal, and Muted Gold.
Use Playfair Display for headings and Inter for everything else.
Build the frontend with React, Tailwind, Framer Motion, and lucide-react.

Use Shadcn UI primarily for the Admin Dashboard and complex interactive components (like forms, modals, tables). For the marketing sections, favor raw HTML/Tailwind to allow for creative, asymmetric layouts.
Do not use any placeholder images (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Implement a custom cursor, smooth scrolling, and page loader to fulfill the ₹5,00,000+ luxury build requirement.
